summary: Assist: staged rollback and live-throttle plan after KV eviction spike during quantization switchover
description: Issue summary: BrightPost reported a sudden increase in 5xx errors and tail latency after enabling a tenant-scoped quantization profile and concurrent KV-prefetch tuning. The customer is on Dedicated capacity and observed sustained elevated error rates starting 2026-03-13 02:20 UTC. They need assisted, low-risk unwind steps and a live traffic policy to avoid a full-service interruption.
impact: Customer-facing production endpoints returning 5xx at ~3-7% and 95p latency increase from 220ms to 1.2s for long sessions. Affects critical healthcare flows and triggers enterprise SLA alarm. No data loss reported. Several API keys show correlated error spikes.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Tenant-level opt-profile activation (quantization=q4_0, kv_prefetch=enabled, batch_target=dynamic)
2) Sustained ~80% concurrency for 30+ minutes
3) Observe eviction churn in KV cache and rising decoder OOM/5xx in logs
4) Repeat with canary traffic split to reproduce behavior in a smaller cohort
logs:
[2026-03-13T02:21:05Z] serving-runtime ERROR decoder: kv_eviction=high tenant=brightpost session=xyz status=500
[2026-03-13T02:21:06Z] scheduler WARN: backpressure triggered for tenant brightpost: queue_depth=94
[2026-03-13T02:23:10Z] optimizer INFO: applied quant_profile q4_0 -> runtime variant q4_0-shim
[2026-03-13T02:25:45Z] gateway ERROR: downstream 5xx spike: 3.6% of requests
(Full logs linked in internal S3: s3://redwood-support/brightpost/2026-03-13/kv-evict/)
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: aggressive quantization profile reduced memory per-tensor but changed allocation patterns; combined with enabled KV-prefetch this increased transient allocation pressure leading to frequent KV eviction and decoder fallback paths that are not optimized for q4-prefixed weights. Observed correlation between quant swap events and sharp rise in eviction metrics. Host-level metrics: GPU memory fragmentation rises ~12% after switchover. Scheduler reports longer queue times for tenant routing policy. No config drift outside opt-profile observed. Reproduction in staging with synthetic traffic reproduced KV thrash when prefetch concurrency set above 64.
resolution: Planned assisted rollback and live-throttle steps provided to customer: 1) Immediate live-throttle: apply tenant traffic cap to 60% of peak and enable fallback routing to CPU-serving pool for non-latency-sensitive routes (support team initiated). 2) Snapshot restore: rehydrate tenant opt-profile snapshot from 2026-03-12 23:50 UTC (per-tenant profile store) to revert quantization to previous q8-like variant. 3) Staged reintroduction: run a 10% canary for 20 minutes with KV-prefetch=disabled, then 30% for 40 minutes while monitoring eviction and 95p latency. 4) If canary stable, re-enable kv-prefetch with a lower concurrency target and a short warmup window. 5) Post-mortem: add a preflight check to optimizer rollout that simulates KV eviction risk for qN profiles under high concurrency. Support runbook updated and PR created to add automated safety gate.
comments: 2026-03-13 03:02 - Aisha Raman (Support): Opened ticket after customer escalation; customer provided logs and temporary grafana snapshots.
2026-03-13 03:18 - Marco Delgado (SRE): Confirmed correlation between quant switchover and KV eviction events. Drafted immediate mitigations: tenant throttling + route fallback.
2026-03-13 03:45 - BrightPost (Customer): Agreed to temporary traffic cap and requested playbook for staged rollback; emphasized minimal downtime requirement.
2026-03-13 04:10 - Marco Delgado (SRE): Executed traffic cap (60%) and enabled fallback routing for non-critical endpoints. Error rate dropped to 0.8% in 12 minutes.

2026-03-13 05:00 - Marco Delgado (SRE): Restored opt-profile snapshot to previous quant variant for tenant; canary started at 10% with kv-prefetch disabled. Monitoring shows eviction metrics normalizing.
2026-03-14 09:20 - Aisha Raman (Support): Follow-up with customer - they report stable performance after staged rollback. Preparing post-mortem and prevention checklist.
follow_up_actions: Add optimizer rollout preflight simulation to detect KV eviction risk for quant profiles
Implement per-tenant soft-throttle policy as an emergency off-ramp
Create automated snapshot-and-revert CLI for Dedicated tenants (support-operated)
Document recommended warmup sequence when enabling kv-prefetch + quant profiles
